name: ChatGPT
plain: A chat assistant you type or talk to that writes, explains, answers questions and makes images.
useFor: Draft emails, letters and posts
Explain a confusing topic in simple words
Summarize a long document you upload
steps: Go to chatgpt.com and sign up with Google, Apple or email.
Type your question in the box and press Enter.
Ask follow-up questions to refine the answer.
price: Free plan. Go (price varies by country), Plus $20/month, Pro from $100/month.
caution: It can state wrong facts confidently, so check anything important. Your chats can be used to train models unless you opt out in settings. The Go plan may show ads.

name: Claude
plain: A chat assistant that is strong at writing, reading long documents and helping with code.
useFor: Rewrite a text in a clearer tone
Ask questions about a long PDF or report
Get help writing or fixing code
steps: Go to claude.ai and sign up with Google or email.
Type a request or attach a file with the paperclip.
Ask follow-up questions in the same chat.
price: Free plan. Pro $20/month ($17/month billed yearly). Max from $100/month.
caution: It can make mistakes, so check important facts. The free plan has usage limits that reset after a few hours. Check privacy settings to choose whether your chats help train models.

name: Google Gemini
plain: Google's chat assistant that answers questions, writes text and works with Gmail, Docs and Drive.
useFor: Ask questions and get answers with Google Search
Summarize emails or files in your Google account
Plan a trip or a weekly schedule
steps: Go to gemini.google.com and sign in with your Google account.
Type or speak your question.
Turn on Google apps in settings if you want it to read Gmail or Drive.
price: Free plan. Google AI Plus $4.99/month, Google AI Pro $19.99/month, Google AI Ultra from $99.99/month.
caution: Answers can be wrong. Google may keep and review chats to improve its services unless you turn off activity saving, so do not paste sensitive data.

name: Microsoft Copilot
plain: Microsoft's chat assistant, built into Windows, Edge and Word, Excel and Outlook with a Microsoft 365 plan.
useFor: Ask quick questions from the Windows taskbar or Edge
Draft a Word document or summarize a long email thread
Get help with formulas and charts in Excel
steps: Go to copilot.microsoft.com or open the Copilot app in Windows.
Sign in with your Microsoft account.
Type or speak your question.
price: Free Copilot app. Copilot inside Office apps comes with Microsoft 365 Personal $9.99/month, Family $12.99/month or Premium $19.99/month.
caution: Copilot inside Word, Excel and Outlook needs a paid Microsoft 365 plan, and usage limits differ by plan. Answers can be wrong.

name: Perplexity
plain: An AI search engine that answers questions in plain words and shows the web sources it used.
useFor: Research a question and see linked sources
Compare products or prices before buying
Get a quick summary of recent news
steps: Go to perplexity.ai and sign in with Google or email.
Type your question like you would in Google.
Click the numbered sources to check the facts.
price: Free plan. Pro $17/month and Max $167/month when billed yearly.
caution: It shows sources, but the summary can misread them. Open the sources for anything that matters.

name: Gemini Notebook (formerly NotebookLM)
plain: Upload your own documents and ask questions about them; answers come only from your files.
useFor: Ask questions about your notes, PDFs or course material
Turn documents into a spoken audio summary
Make study guides and slides from your sources
steps: Go to notebook.google and sign in with your Google account.
Create a notebook and add PDFs, Google Docs, links or videos.
Ask questions in the chat and click citations to see the source.
price: Free plan. Higher limits come with Google AI Plus, Pro or Ultra subscriptions.
caution: Google renamed NotebookLM to Gemini Notebook in July 2026; it is the same product. The free plan allows up to 50 sources per notebook.

name: Consensus
plain: A search engine that answers questions using published scientific studies and cites each one.
useFor: Check what studies say about a health or science question
Find peer-reviewed papers for a school assignment
Get a short overview of research on a topic
steps: Go to consensus.app and sign up with Google or email.
Ask a yes/no or research question in plain words.
Open the listed papers to read the original findings.
price: Free plan. Pro from $12/month and Deep from $45/month when billed yearly.
caution: It only covers published research, and summaries can oversimplify. The free plan gives 10 Pro messages and 3 deep reviews per month.

name: Elicit
plain: A research assistant that finds scientific papers, summarizes them and pulls key facts into a table.
useFor: Find papers on a research question
Compare findings across many studies in one table
Start a literature review for a thesis
steps: Go to elicit.com and create a free account.
Type your research question.
Pick papers and add columns for the details you want pulled out.
price: Free Basic plan. Pro $49/month and Scale $169/month, billed yearly.
caution: The free plan limits the research agent and reports. Extracted details can be wrong, so check them against the paper.

name: Grammarly
plain: Checks spelling, grammar and tone as you type, and can rewrite sentences for you.
useFor: Fix spelling and grammar in emails and documents
Make a message sound more polite or confident
Rewrite a paragraph to be shorter and clearer
steps: Go to grammarly.com and sign up for free.
Install the browser extension or desktop app.
Type as usual and click the underlined words to accept fixes.
price: Free plan. Pro EUR 12/month (price shown in EU; varies by country).
caution: Once installed it reads the text you type in many apps. Check your employer's rules before using it on confidential documents.

name: QuillBot
plain: Rewrites sentences in different words, checks grammar and summarizes text.
useFor: Reword a sentence that sounds awkward
Summarize an article into key points
Check grammar and generate citations
steps: Go to quillbot.com and paste your text into the Paraphraser.
Pick a writing mode and click Paraphrase.
Sign up for free to save your work.
price: Free plan with limits. Premium plan (price not shown without signing in).
caution: Rewording someone else's text does not make it your own work; schools may treat it as plagiarism. The free plan limits text length and modes.

name: DeepL
plain: Translates text and whole documents between many languages with natural-sounding results.
useFor: Translate an email or web text
Translate a Word or PDF file and keep its layout
Polish your writing in another language
steps: Go to deepl.com/translator.
Paste text or drop in a file, then pick the target language.
Click alternative words to adjust the translation.
price: Free plan. Pro Individual EUR 7.49/month billed yearly (price shown in EU).
caution: The free plan allows 50,000 characters and 1 file per month. Check DeepL's privacy terms before translating confidential text on the free plan.

name: Notion AI
plain: AI built into the Notion notes app that writes, summarizes and answers questions about your pages.
useFor: Summarize long notes into action points
Ask questions across your team's pages
Draft a document or plan from a short prompt
steps: Go to notion.com and sign up for free.
Create a page and press space to ask the AI.
Upgrade to a paid plan to keep using AI after the trial.
price: Free plan includes only an AI trial. Plus EUR 9.50/month and Business EUR 19.50/month include Notion AI (prices shown in EU).
caution: Meeting notes and search across other apps need the Business plan or higher. The AI sees the pages you ask it about.

name: Gamma
plain: Makes presentations, documents and simple websites from a short description.
useFor: Turn an outline into a slide deck
Convert a PDF or notes into a presentation
Export slides to PowerPoint or Google Slides
steps: Go to gamma.app and sign up for free.
Click Create and describe the presentation you need.
Edit the slides, then export or share a link.
price: Free plan. Plus $9/month, Pro $18/month, Ultra $90/month when billed yearly.
caution: The free plan gives 400 credits once at signup, not every month, and adds Gamma branding. Check facts the AI adds to slides.

name: Otter.ai
plain: Records meetings, writes a transcript and gives you a summary with action items.
useFor: Get a written transcript of a Zoom, Meet or Teams call
Receive a meeting summary with action items
Search past meetings for what was said
steps: Go to otter.ai and sign up with Google or Microsoft.
Connect your calendar so it can join meetings.
Open the transcript and summary after the meeting.
price: Free plan with 300 minutes/month. Pro $16.99/month ($8.33/month billed yearly). Business $30/month ($19.99/month billed yearly).
caution: Tell others you are recording; some places require consent. Transcripts can mishear names and technical words.

name: Granola
plain: A meeting notepad that listens on your computer and turns your rough notes into clean meeting notes.
useFor: Get tidy notes after a video call
Ask questions about what was said across meetings
Share meeting notes with your team
steps: Go to granola.ai and download the app.
Sign in and connect your calendar.
Start a meeting, jot quick notes, and let Granola fill them in.
price: Free Basic plan. Business $14/user/month, Enterprise $35/user/month.
caution: The free plan shows only limited meeting history. Tell others the meeting is being transcribed.

name: Midjourney
plain: Type a description and it paints detailed, artistic pictures and short video clips for you.
useFor: Create artwork or illustrations from a written description
Make mood boards and concept images for a project
Turn a still image into a short animated clip
steps: Go to midjourney.com and sign in.
Pick a subscription plan; there is no free plan.
Type what you want to see in the prompt box and press Enter.
price: No free plan. Basic $10/month, Standard $30, Pro $60, Mega $120; 20% less if paid yearly.
caution: Images are public on the site unless you pay for Pro or Mega (Stealth Mode). Companies earning over $1M a year must use Pro or Mega.

name: Canva (Magic Studio / Canva AI)
plain: A drag-and-drop design app with built-in AI that drafts, resizes and edits designs for you.
useFor: Design social posts, flyers and presentations from templates
Remove photo backgrounds or resize a design in one click
Ask the AI to draft a design or text from a prompt
steps: Create a free account at canva.com.
Pick a template or type what you want to make.
Use the AI tools in the editor, then download or share.
price: Free plan with a small AI allowance. Paid Pro and Business plans; price depends on your country (Pro about EUR 110/year in Europe).
caution: The free plan only includes about 20 AI uses; heavier AI use needs Pro, Business or the paid AI Pass add-on.

name: Adobe Firefly
plain: Adobe's AI tool that makes and edits images, video and audio from text descriptions.
useFor: Generate images for marketing or presentations
Fill in or remove parts of a photo
Create short video clips or voiceovers from text
steps: Go to firefly.adobe.com and sign in with an Adobe account.
Choose image, video or audio and type a description.
Download the result or send it to Photoshop or Express.
price: Free daily generations with limits. Paid plans: Standard, Pro, Pro Plus, Premium; price depends on your country (Standard about EUR 11/month in Europe).
caution: Adobe says its own Firefly models are safe for commercial use, but partner models offered in the app may have different terms.

name: Ideogram
plain: Makes images from a description and is especially good at putting readable text into pictures.
useFor: Make posters, logos or social graphics with correct lettering
Create product mockups and ad images
Keep the same character across several images
steps: Sign up free at ideogram.ai.
Type a description, including any words you want shown.
Pick the best of the generated images and download it.
price: Free plan with weekly slow credits. Paid from $15/month billed yearly ($20 month to month).
caution: On the free plan your images are public; private generation needs a paid plan.

name: Krea
plain: One site that gives you many image and video AI models, including live drawing that updates as you sketch.
useFor: Generate images or videos with different AI models in one place
Sketch roughly and watch AI turn it into a picture
Upscale and sharpen low-quality images
steps: Sign up free at krea.ai.
Choose a tool such as Image, Video or Realtime.
Type a prompt or draw, then download what you like.
price: Free plan with a small daily allowance. Paid from $9/month (less if billed yearly).
caution: Check which plan includes the commercial license before using results for work.

name: Leonardo AI
plain: Creates images, designs and short videos from text, with ready-made styles for common looks.
useFor: Make game art, characters or product shots
Pick a style preset and generate images in that look
Turn an image into a short motion clip
steps: Sign up free at leonardo.ai.
Open the image creator and choose a style preset.
Type a description, generate, and download.
price: Free plan with daily tokens. Paid plans from $12/month.
caution: Free-plan creations are public; private creations need a paid plan.

name: Runway
plain: Makes and edits short videos from text or images using AI.
useFor: Turn a photo or description into a short video clip
Remove or replace objects and backgrounds in video
Generate music, voice or sound effects for a clip
steps: Sign up at runwayml.com; you get a one-time set of free credits.
Pick a tool such as text-to-video and type a prompt.
Review the clip and download it.
price: 125 one-time free credits to try it. Paid from $12/month billed yearly ($15 month to month).
caution: Video uses credits fast, so a few seconds of footage can use up a month's allowance.

name: Kling AI
plain: Turns text or pictures into realistic short videos with sound.
useFor: Turn a photo into a moving video clip
Generate a short scene from a written description
Copy a person's movement from one video onto a character
steps: Sign up at kling.ai.
Choose video or image creation and upload a picture or type a prompt.
Wait for the result and download it.
price: Free Basic plan with limits. Paid from Standard, listed at $10/month, with first-month discounts.
caution: On the free plan videos carry a watermark and are not cleared for commercial use; those need a paid plan.

name: HeyGen
plain: Makes videos of a realistic digital presenter reading your script, in many languages.
useFor: Make a training or sales video without filming
Translate a video into another language with matching lips
Create a digital version of yourself to present videos
steps: Sign up free at heygen.com.
Pick a stock avatar or create your own, then paste your script.
Generate the video and download or share it.
price: Free plan: 3 videos a month, up to 1 minute. Paid from $24/month billed yearly ($29 month to month).
caution: Free videos have a watermark. Only make an avatar or voice clone of yourself or someone who has clearly agreed.

name: Synthesia
plain: Turns a written script into a video with a lifelike presenter, aimed at company training and explainers.
useFor: Turn a document or slides into a training video
Update a video by editing the text instead of refilming
Dub a video into other languages
steps: Sign up free at synthesia.io.
Start from a template, choose an avatar and paste your script.
Generate the video and share the link or download it.
price: Free plan: 10 minutes of video a month. Paid from $18/month billed yearly ($29 month to month).
caution: Free videos show the Synthesia logo. Personal avatars of real people need a paid plan and that person's consent.

name: CapCut
plain: A free video editor for phone and computer with AI tools for captions, effects and quick edits.
useFor: Edit short videos for TikTok, Reels or YouTube Shorts
Add automatic captions to a video
Remove backgrounds or apply templates and effects
steps: Install the CapCut app or open capcut.com in a browser.
Import your video clips.
Add captions, music or effects, then export.
price: Free to use. Paid Standard and Pro plans; price depends on your country and device.
caution: Many AI tools and effects are Pro-only. Owned by ByteDance (TikTok's parent); read the terms before using it for client or business work.

name: Descript
plain: Edit video and podcasts by editing the written transcript, like a text document.
useFor: Cut a video or podcast by deleting words from the transcript
Remove filler words and background noise automatically
Add captions and export clips for social media
steps: Sign up free at descript.com and install the app or use the web version.
Upload or record audio or video; it writes the transcript.
Edit the text to edit the media, then export.
price: Free plan: 1 hour of media a month, 720p export. Paid from $16/month billed yearly ($24 month to month).
caution: Watermark-free export starts with paid plans. Only use voice cloning on your own voice or with clear permission.

name: Opus Clip
plain: Cuts a long video into short, captioned clips ready for social media.
useFor: Turn a podcast or webinar into short social clips
Add animated captions automatically
Reframe wide videos into vertical format
steps: Sign up free at opus.pro.
Paste a video link or upload a long video.
Pick the clips you like and download or post them.
price: Free plan: 60 credits a month. Paid from $15/month (Starter), Pro $29/month.
caution: Free clips have a watermark, cannot be edited, and can only be exported for 3 days.

name: ElevenLabs
plain: Turns written text into natural-sounding speech and can copy a voice from a short recording.
useFor: Create a voiceover for a video or presentation
Turn an article or book into audio
Dub a recording into another language
steps: Sign up free at elevenlabs.io.
Paste text into Text to Speech and choose a voice.
Generate the audio and download it.
price: Free plan with 10,000 credits a month. Paid from $6/month (Starter).
caution: The commercial license starts with the paid Starter plan. Only clone your own voice or a voice you have permission to use.

name: Suno
plain: Makes complete songs with vocals and music from a short description or your own lyrics.
useFor: Create a song for a birthday, video or event
Turn your own lyrics into a finished track
Make background music in a chosen style
steps: Sign up free at suno.com.
Describe the song or paste your lyrics and pick a style.
Listen to the versions and save the one you like.
price: Free plan with 50 credits a day. Paid from $8/month billed yearly (Pro); Premier also available.
caution: The free plan has no commercial rights and no monthly song downloads; you need Pro or Premier to use songs commercially.

name: Lovable
plain: Describe an app or website in plain words and it builds a working version you can publish.
useFor: Build a simple website or landing page from a description
Make a small internal tool, like a booking form
Turn an idea into a clickable prototype to show others
steps: Sign up at lovable.dev with an email or Google account.
Type what you want to build in the chat box and send it.
Ask for changes in plain words, then press Publish to get a link.
price: Free plan with 5 credits a day (up to 30 a month). Pro 25 EUR/month incl. VAT and Business 50 EUR/month, as shown from Europe.
caution: Every message uses credits, and the free ones run out fast on bigger projects. Check the app for security holes before you put real customer data in it.

name: Bolt.new
plain: A chat in your browser that writes, runs and hosts a website or app from your description.
useFor: Build a website or web app by describing it
Try out an app idea before paying a developer
Host a finished project online with one click
steps: Open bolt.new and sign in.
Describe the app you want in the prompt box.
Test it in the preview, ask for fixes, then deploy it.
price: Free plan with 1M tokens a month (300K a day). Pro $25/month, Teams $30 per member/month.
caution: Tokens are used up quickly when the AI gets stuck fixing its own errors. Larger apps usually still need a developer to clean up the code.

name: v0
plain: Describe a web page or app and it designs and codes it, ready to put online.
useFor: Design a web page or dashboard from a sentence
Turn a screenshot or sketch into a working page
Publish a small web app on Vercel
steps: Go to v0.app and sign in.
Describe the page or app you want, or upload a screenshot.
Refine it through chat, then click Publish.
price: Free plan with $5 of credits a month and 7 messages a day. Plus $30/user/month, Business $100/user/month.
caution: The free message limit is small. The output is real code, so fixing anything beyond simple changes gets technical.

name: Replit
plain: An online workspace where an AI agent builds, runs and publishes apps for you.
useFor: Build a web app by chatting with the Replit Agent
Publish an app with its own database online
Learn to code in the browser without installing anything
steps: Create a free account at replit.com.
Describe your app to the Agent on the home screen.
Review the result, ask for changes, then publish it.
price: Free Starter plan with small daily Agent credits and 1 published app. Core $20/month ($18 yearly), Pro $100/month ($90 yearly).
caution: Agent work is billed by effort, so costs can climb on complex apps. Set a spending limit in your account.

name: Cursor
plain: A code editor for your computer with an AI that writes and edits code alongside you.
useFor: Write or change code by describing what you want
Ask questions about a large codebase
Let an agent fix bugs across many files
steps: Download Cursor for Windows, Mac or Linux from cursor.com.
Open a project folder on your computer.
Open the Agent panel and describe the change you want.
price: Free Hobby plan with limited Agent requests. Pro $20/month, Pro+ $60/month, Ultra $200/month, Teams $40/user/month.
caution: Made for people who can read code; the AI can make confident mistakes. Your code is sent to AI providers unless you turn on privacy mode.

name: Windsurf (now Devin Desktop)
plain: An AI code editor, now renamed Devin Desktop, where agents write and fix code for you.
useFor: Write and edit code with an AI agent
Run several coding agents and track them in one place
Get autocomplete suggestions while you type code
steps: Download Devin Desktop from devin.ai/desktop; Windsurf users get it as an update.
Sign in and open a project folder.
Describe a task to the agent and review its changes.
price: Free plan with a light agent quota and unlimited autocomplete. Pro $20/month, Max $200/month (Devin plans).
caution: windsurf.com now redirects to Devin, so older guides and screenshots may not match. Meant for people comfortable with code.

name: GitHub Copilot
plain: An AI helper inside code editors that suggests code and answers programming questions.
useFor: Get code suggestions as you type in VS Code
Ask why code is broken and how to fix it
Have an agent draft a change and open a pull request
steps: Sign in to GitHub and turn on Copilot Free in settings.
Install the GitHub Copilot extension in VS Code or another editor.
Start typing code or open Copilot Chat and ask a question.
price: Free plan with 2,000 code completions and 50 chat requests a month. Pro $10/month, Pro+ $39/month, Max $100/month.
caution: Suggestions can look right but be wrong or insecure; always check them. Needs a GitHub account.

name: Zapier
plain: Connects your apps so routine tasks happen automatically, now with AI helpers and agents.
useFor: Copy new form answers into a spreadsheet automatically
Send a Slack message when an important email arrives
Set up an AI agent that sorts and answers requests
steps: Create a free account at zapier.com.
Describe the task to Copilot or pick a ready template.
Connect your accounts, test once, then switch it on.
price: Free plan with 100 tasks a month and two-step Zaps. Professional from $19.99/month yearly ($29.99 monthly), Team from $69/month yearly.
caution: Each automated step counts as a task and the cost rises with volume. Zapier gets access to every account you connect.

name: Make
plain: A visual board where you link apps together to build automations and AI agents.
useFor: Build a flow that moves data between apps on a schedule
Add AI steps to sort or summarize incoming emails
Automate reports from spreadsheets and forms
steps: Sign up free at make.com.
Create a new scenario and add the apps you want to connect.
Run it once to test, then set a schedule.
price: Free plan with 1,000 credits a month. Core $9/month yearly ($10.59 monthly), Pro $16/month, Teams $29/month for 10,000 credits.
caution: More flexible than Zapier but takes longer to learn. Every action uses credits, and the AI Agents feature is still in beta.

name: Manus
plain: An AI agent you give a task to, and it researches, browses and produces the result.
useFor: Research a topic and get a written report
Make slides or a simple website from a request
Schedule repeating tasks, like a weekly summary
steps: Sign up at manus.im.
Type the task you want done in detail.
Watch its progress, then download or share the result.
price: Free plan with 300 credits a day. Paid plans shown at $20, $40 and $200/month (4,000 to 40,000 credits a month).
caution: Credits go fast on long tasks. In August 2026 Manus split from Meta and deleted some users' data, so keep your own copies of important work.

name: LM Studio
plain: A free desktop app that runs AI chat models on your own computer, offline.
useFor: Chat with an AI without sending data to the internet
Download and try open models like Llama or Qwen
Run a local AI for other apps to use
steps: Download LM Studio for Windows, Mac or Linux from lmstudio.ai.
Open the model search, pick a model that fits your computer, download it.
Load the model and start chatting.
price: Free to run models on your computer. Optional cloud plans: Bionic+ $20/month, Pro $100/month.
caution: Models are large downloads and need a reasonably powerful computer; small local models are less capable than ChatGPT or Claude. The optional cloud plans send prompts to US servers.

name: Fireflies.ai
plain: Joins your online meetings, writes down what was said and summarizes it for you.
useFor: Get a transcript and summary of a Zoom or Teams call
Search past meetings for what was decided
Share action items with your team after a call
steps: Sign up at fireflies.ai with your work Google or Microsoft account.
Connect your calendar so it can join your meetings.
After a meeting, open the notes and summary in your dashboard.
price: Free plan with transcription, limited AI summaries and 400 minutes of storage. Pro $10/seat/month yearly ($18 monthly), Business $19 yearly ($29 monthly).
caution: A bot joins your calls and recordings are stored on Fireflies' servers; tell participants and check your company rules first.

name: Udio
plain: Makes full songs with vocals from a short text description of the style and lyrics.
useFor: Create a song from a text description
Write custom lyrics and have them sung
Extend or remix a song you made
steps: Sign up at udio.com.
Describe the style and topic, or paste your own lyrics.
Listen to the two versions it makes and extend the one you like.
price: Free plan with 10 credits a day (100 a month). Standard $10/month ($8 yearly), Pro $30/month ($24 yearly).
caution: Since October 2025 downloads are disabled after Udio's deal with Universal Music, so songs can only be played on Udio.

name: Beautiful.ai
plain: Makes presentation slides for you and keeps the layout neat as you add content.
useFor: Turn a topic or outline into a slide deck
Keep slides consistent with your company colors
Export a deck to PowerPoint or share a link
steps: Start the 14-day trial at beautiful.ai.
Describe your presentation or pick a template.
Edit the text, then present, share a link or export.
price: No free plan; 14-day trial needs a card. Pro $14.50/month yearly or $45 for one month, Team $40/user/month yearly.
caution: Remember to cancel the trial if you do not want to be charged. Automatic layouts limit how freely you can move things.

name: Microsoft Designer
plain: Makes images, cards, invitations and social posts from a short description, free with a Microsoft account.
useFor: Create a birthday card or invitation from a sentence
Make an image or sticker for social media
Remove a background or unwanted object from a photo
steps: Go to designer.microsoft.com and sign in with a Microsoft account.
Pick what to make, like an image or card, and describe it.
Choose a result, edit the text, then download or share.
price: Free with monthly AI credits. Microsoft 365 Personal ($9.99/month) and Family ($12.99/month) give higher usage.
caution: Free credits are limited each month and shared with other Microsoft AI features.
